bugs.error_message: A read-only rg existence check returned exit code 1 because HOTEL_STANDARDS_EXECUTION_PLAN.md did not yet exist
bugs.root_cause: Ripgrep uses exit code 1 for a valid no-match result; the command wrapper treated the expected absence of the new deliverable as a failed script.
bugs.fix: Create the requested plan and use Test-Path or Select-String for future no-match checks where absence is expected.

bugs.error_message: PowerShell production probe rejected the unsupported -SkipHttpErrorCheck parameter

bugs.error_message: Focused API health test command used a repository-relative virtualenv path after changing into apps/api

bugs.fix: Run the environment interpreter as .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe from apps/api, or use the configured global Python if the virtualenv is absent.

bugs.error_message: Health endpoint returned 200 while reporting database unavailable
bugs.root_cause: The health endpoint encoded the failed dependency only in its JSON body, so load balancers and deployment checks considered a degraded API healthy.
bugs.fix: Return 503 with no-store cache control when the database probe fails; preserve a 200 response only when both API and database are ready.

bugs.error_message: Health smoke tests required 200 even when their test environment intentionally has no valid database connection
bugs.root_cause: The test contract predated readiness semantics and treated a degraded body as a successful transport response.
bugs.fix: Allow 200 for ready and 503 for degraded health in environment-agnostic smoke tests; retain a focused assertion that a failed database probe is 503.

bugs.error_message: TypeScript could not retain the non-null health URL narrowing inside the asynchronous login health-check closure
bugs.root_cause: The nullable health URL was captured by a nested asynchronous function after its guard clause.
bugs.fix: Pass the already-narrowed endpoint to the asynchronous function as a required string parameter.

bugs.error_message: Phase 0 login smoke reproduced a permanently disabled form and pending health status at 127.0.0.1

bugs.root_cause: The API tests configure environment variables in individual test modules rather than a shared conftest fixture.
bugs.fix: Use the existing smoke-test modules as fixtures and add focused Phase 1 tests in a dedicated module.

bugs.error_message: Focused test command resolved the Python executable as apps/api/apps/api/.venv/Scripts/python.exe
bugs.root_cause: The command used a repository-relative virtual-environment path after changing the working directory to apps/api.
bugs.fix: Run API checks from apps/api with .\.venv\Scripts\python -m pytest.

bugs.error_message: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'services.work_orders' during Phase 1 transition-contract test collection
bugs.root_cause: The test was intentionally written before the explicit work-order transition service existed.
bugs.fix: Add services/work_orders/transitions.py with the canonical transition table and validation rules.

bugs.error_message: ImportError: cannot import name 'TransitionWorkOrderRequest' from models.requests during endpoint-contract test collection
bugs.root_cause: The API contract did not yet expose the explicit transition request payload.
bugs.fix: Add TransitionWorkOrderRequest and route state changes through the transition RPC.

bugs.error_message: AttributeError: 'Result' object has no attribute 'execute' in the transition endpoint test double
bugs.root_cause: The Supabase RPC double returned a result directly instead of the query object returned by the SDK.
bugs.fix: Make the RPC test double return an object with execute() that exposes the result payload.

bugs.error_message: PowerShell parsed the parentheses in apps/mobile/app/(app)/work-orders as a command expression
bugs.root_cause: A path containing parentheses was passed to rg without quoting.
bugs.fix: Quote all PowerShell paths that contain parentheses.

bugs.error_message: apply_patch could not match the Phase 0 heading in .planning/STATE.md
bugs.root_cause: The context contained mojibake for the em dash while the file is UTF-8.
bugs.fix: Use the exact UTF-8 heading text from a targeted read before updating milestone state.

bugs.error_message: Second .planning/STATE.md patch did not match the UTF-8 Phase 0 heading
bugs.root_cause: The patch still retained an encoding-sensitive context line.
bugs.fix: Insert Phase 1 state using only ASCII section-heading context.

bugs.error_message: Railway project access returned Unauthorized; public web and API endpoints both return Railway 404
bugs.root_cause: The Railway CLI OAuth session is expired, preventing service/domain inspection or deployment; provisioned domains currently have no reachable deployment.
bugs.fix: Re-authenticate the Railway account, restore both service domains, deploy the verified code, and re-run public probes.

bugs.error_message: rg rejected Windows wildcard component paths while inspecting occupancy controls
bugs.root_cause: Windows path wildcard syntax was used as a literal rg search path.
bugs.fix: Use `rg --files` to resolve matching directories before passing concrete paths to rg.

bugs.error_message: Work-order claim mutates the row directly and bypasses the atomic transition-audit RPC
bugs.root_cause: The legacy claim route predates the Phase 1 transition service.
bugs.fix: Route claims through transition_work_order_with_audit and record assignment in the same database function.

bugs.error_message: UpdateWorkOrderRequest rejects the canonical escalated status
bugs.root_cause: The legacy PATCH request enum was not synchronized with the Phase 1 status contract.
bugs.fix: Use the canonical status type in the PATCH payload, then reject status changes at the route boundary in favor of the explicit transition endpoint.

bugs.error_message: Ruff reported an unused CompleteWorkOrderRequest import in transition tests
bugs.root_cause: A planned completion-route test was not added with the claim-route test.
bugs.fix: Remove the unused import before rerunning lint.

bugs.error_message: An apply_patch attempt for the lint cleanup used malformed bug-log patch context
bugs.root_cause: The patch mixed an incomplete JSON insertion with file-edit context.
bugs.fix: Apply the bug-log and test cleanup with separate, validated patch hunks.

bugs.error_message: The new Railway API public domain was initially configured for port 8000 while Uvicorn was listening on Railway's injected port 8080.
bugs.root_cause: The domain target port was supplied manually instead of being verified from runtime deploy logs.
bugs.fix: Set the public-domain target port to 8080 and verify the external health endpoint after the update.

bugs.error_message: A long browser status wait timed out and reset the browser session.
bugs.root_cause: The browser automation kernel timeout was shorter than the requested wait plus page inspection.
bugs.fix: Use short deployment polls and reinitialize the browser binding after a kernel reset.

bugs.error_message: The web validation command used bash-style && in the PowerShell shell.
bugs.root_cause: The workspace shell is an older PowerShell version that does not support && as a statement separator.
bugs.fix: Use semicolons and explicitly stop when $LASTEXITCODE is nonzero.

bugs.error_message: The targeted API lint/type command used a parent-directory virtual-environment path that does not exist.
bugs.root_cause: The API virtual environment is located at apps/api/.venv, not the repository root.
bugs.fix: Run Ruff and Pyright through .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe from apps/api.

bugs.error_message: The mobile work-order queue ranked emergency work behind urgent work.
bugs.root_cause: The canonical emergency priority was absent from the mobile union and queue-ranking logic.
bugs.fix: Add emergency and escalated to the mobile domain contract and rank emergency work first in active queues.

bugs.error_message: The mobile translation search assumed a nonexistent apps/mobile/i18n/locales directory.
bugs.root_cause: Translation files are organized outside the assumed locale-directory convention.
bugs.fix: Resolve the actual translation file paths with rg --files before reading or editing keys.

bugs.error_message: The follow-up mobile locale filename search returned no matches.
bugs.root_cause: The search pattern was narrower than the project's translation-file naming convention.
bugs.fix: Search for a known active key across apps/mobile to identify the owning translation module.

bugs.error_message: Mobile TypeScript validation is blocked by existing role-union, duplicate-key, and UserProfile-shape errors outside the emergency/escalation change.
bugs.root_cause: The mobile project already contains unrelated type-contract drift in the dirty worktree.
bugs.fix: Isolate and repair the existing mobile type errors before treating a full mobile type check as green; the focused work-order test passes.

bugs.error_message: A PowerShell inspection command failed because its mixed quote pattern left a string unterminated.
bugs.root_cause: The rg expression used incompatible nested single and double quotes.
bugs.fix: Split the inspection into quote-safe PowerShell commands.

bugs.error_message: Phase 1 override validation still recognized the retired chief_engineer role after migration 064 merged it into engineer.
bugs.root_cause: The transition service had not been reconciled with the role consolidation migration.
bugs.fix: Treat engineer and GM as management for controlled work-order overrides and update the focused contract test.

bugs.error_message: A large inspection-modal patch could not match the existing malformed text encoding around a placeholder.
bugs.root_cause: The source contains mojibake, so exact context containing the ellipsis did not match the patch text.
bugs.fix: Apply the modal change in smaller context-safe patches that avoid the malformed placeholder text.

bugs.error_message: Inspection modal TypeScript validation failed because a conditional JSX branch had an input and label as sibling roots.
bugs.root_cause: Photo-evidence controls were added after an existing input without a wrapper element.
bugs.fix: Wrap the failed-item note and evidence controls in one container, then rerun the web type check.

bugs.error_message: A migration inspection command referenced a nonexistent 012_notifications.sql file.
bugs.root_cause: The notifications table was created in migration 013_ai_systems.sql, not migration 012.
bugs.fix: Use migration 013 as the notifications schema source when adding delivery history.

bugs.root_cause: Async call without await — returned Promise instead of value
